description: This file contains utility functions for managing session data, including loading, merging, and classifying session entries, as well as resolving session models and generating session summaries. It interacts with session store files, session keys, and session metadata, and exports functions for session management within a larger application.

methods.name: tryResolveExistingPath
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a given path to its real path, returning null if it fails.

methods.name: resolveIdentityAvatarUrl
methods.description: Resolves a URL for an agent's avatar, handling data URLs, HTTP URLs, and workspace-relative paths, including reading file content and encoding as base64 data URL.

methods.name: formatSessionIdPrefix
methods.description: Creates a session ID prefix, optionally appending a date if 'updatedAt' is provided.

methods.name: truncateTitle
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, adding an ellipsis if truncated.

methods.name: deriveSessionTitle
methods.description: Generates a session title based on displayName, subject, first user message, or session ID.

methods.name: resolveSessionRuntimeMs
methods.description: Calculates the runtime in milliseconds for a session run.

methods.name: resolvePositiveNumber
methods.description: Returns the number if it is a finite, positive number; otherwise undefined.

methods.name: resolveNonNegativeNumber
methods.description: Returns the number if it is a finite, non-negative number; otherwise undefined.

methods.name: resolveEstimatedSessionCostUsd
methods.description: Estimates the USD cost of a session based on tokens and model cost configuration.

methods.name: resolveChildSessionKeys
methods.description: Finds child session keys spawned by a controller session key.

methods.name: resolveTranscriptUsageFallback
methods.description: Attempts to read session usage data from transcript and provides fallback info.

methods.name: loadSessionEntry
methods.description: Loads session store data and returns session entry details, including canonical and legacy keys.

methods.name: resolveFreshestSessionStoreMatchFromStoreKeys
methods.description: Finds the most recent session store match from a list of store keys.

methods.name: resolveFreshestSessionEntryFromStoreKeys
methods.description: Returns the most recent session entry from store keys.

methods.name: findFreshestStoreMatch
methods.description: Finds the most recent store match among candidates.

methods.name: findStoreKeysIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds all store keys case-insensitively matching a target key.

methods.name: pruneLegacyStoreKeys
methods.description: Removes legacy or alias keys from the store, keeping only current keys.

methods.name: migrateAndPruneGatewaySessionStoreKey
methods.description: Migrates and prunes session store keys, updating the store with the latest session data.

methods.name: classifySessionKey
methods.description: Classifies a session key as 'global', 'unknown', 'group', or 'direct'.

methods.name: parseGroupKey
methods.description: Parses a group or channel key into its components.

methods.name: isStorePathTemplate
methods.description: Checks if a store path string is a template containing '{agentId}'.

methods.name: listExistingAgentIdsFromDisk
methods.description: Lists agent IDs from the filesystem directory.

methods.name: listConfiguredAgentIds
methods.description: Lists configured agent IDs from configuration and disk.

methods.name: normalizeFallbackList
methods.description: Normalizes a list of fallback agent IDs, removing duplicates and trimming.

methods.name: resolveGatewayAgentModel
methods.description: Resolves primary and fallback models for an agent.

methods.name: listAgentsForGateway
methods.description: Lists agents configured for the gateway, including their models and identities.

methods.name: canonicalizeSessionKeyForAgent
methods.description: Canonicalizes a session key for an agent, adding 'agent:' prefix if needed.

methods.name: resolveDefaultStoreAgentId
methods.description: Resolves the default agent ID for store purposes.

methods.name: resolveSessionStoreKey
methods.description: Resolves a session key into its canonical form, handling special cases.

methods.name: resolveSessionStoreAgentId
methods.description: Resolves the agent ID from a canonical session key.

methods.name: canonicalizeSpawnedByForAgent
methods.description: Canonicalizes the 'spawnedBy' field for an agent, resolving aliases.

methods.name: buildGatewaySessionStoreScanTargets
methods.description: Builds a list of session keys to scan for in the store.

methods.name: resolveGatewaySessionStoreCandidates
methods.description: Resolves candidate session store targets for an agent.

methods.name: resolveGatewaySessionStoreLookup
methods.description: Finds the best session store and match for a given key.

methods.name: resolveGatewaySessionStoreTarget
methods.description: Resolves the session store target, including store path and keys.

methods.name: mergeSessionEntryIntoCombined
methods.description: Merges a session entry into a combined store, preferring latest updated.

methods.name: loadCombinedSessionStoreForGateway
methods.description: Loads and merges session store data from multiple targets into a combined store.

methods.name: getSessionDefaults
methods.description: Returns default session model, provider, and context tokens.

methods.name: resolveSessionModelRef
methods.description: Resolves the session model reference, considering overrides and defaults.

methods.name: resolveGatewayModelSupportsImages
methods.description: Checks if a model supports images by querying the model catalog.

methods.name: resolveSessionModelIdentityRef
methods.description: Resolves the session model identity, including provider and model.

methods.name: buildGatewaySessionRow
methods.description: Builds a detailed session row for listing, including metadata and usage info.

methods.name: loadGatewaySessionRow
methods.description: Loads a session row for a given session key.

methods.name: listSessionsFromStore
methods.description: Lists sessions from a store with filtering and sorting options.
